name: Kim Min-seo
bio:
Kim Min-seo's journey into motorsport began with a fascination for the intricate engineering of Formula 1 cars. After graduating at the top of her class in mechanical engineering from Seoul National University, she quickly immersed herself in the world of racing, starting with a small Korean racing team. Her meticulous approach to problem-solving and her ability to dissect complex technical challenges quickly made her an invaluable asset. 

Over the years, Kim's career progressed through various roles, from vehicle dynamics specialist to head of R&D. She emphasizes data-driven decision-making and strives to foster a collaborative environment where engineers can openly exchange ideas. What distinguishes Kim is her talent for identifying marginal gains through innovative solutions, often overlooked by others. She is always looking for creative opportunities to apply her analytical mindset to improve performance, efficiency, and overall team functionality.

Kim is known for her rigorous testing processes and her ability to translate complex data into actionable insights for the team. Her approach, though demanding, has consistently yielded positive results. She values precision and clarity above all else.
